rationale: Mufaddal brings 15+ years of embedded systems and firmware expertise across automotive, IoT, and connectivity—including embedded Linux, C++, and OTA architecture—while Miguel is actively building real-time operating systems and firmware drivers at companies like NVIDIA and Cisco Meraki. Miguel's hands-on embedded systems work and deep interest in the inner workings of hardware from transistors up align well with Mufaddal's mentorship-level depth, and Mufaddal's automotive and connectivity background could offer valuable context for Miguel's robotics and firmware trajectory.
intro_message: Mufaddal, meet Miguel Villa Floran—a Cal Poly embedded systems engineer currently working on firmware and hardware bring-up at NVIDIA and Meraki who shares your focus on low-level embedded Linux and C++, and could benefit from your decade-plus experience shipping production firmware across automotive and IoT.
